title: Curb Rights (Part 2)
description: The marriage-of-convenience is out: one L L C, two windows, and a dead generator nobody will restart. Tonight Donna and Chen call back to divorce the business, and the lawyer who called it smart phones in to defend himself, live, in the dark.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're back on Snazzie FM, and the block is still dark. Donna, Chen, last we left it, you two are one business, one marriage, two windows, and one generator nobody will turn on. Where are we now?

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: We're divorcing, Ronnie. The business and the man. Same paperwork, sweetheart, the lawyer says.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The same lawyer who said the marriage was smart.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: He is on line two, Barry. He wants to talk.

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: I just want it on the record that, structurally, it WAS smart. One filing fee. One tax return. You two saved nine hundred dollars a year, I have the spreadsheet.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Nine hundred dollars, sweetheart, and a husband I have to unplug.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: She unplugged the whole generator this time, Marv. Not the cord. The generator. It is cold.

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: Okay, and... who owns the generator, per the operating agreement?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: The L L C.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: And the cord?

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: ...Also the L L C.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So the cord and the generator are married to each other too. That's a beautiful thing, when you think about it.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Nobody's eating, Ronnie. Both windows are dark.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Then split it, Marv. He takes the generator, I take the cord, we file the dissolution, we never speak. That's the deal, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: I... can't split it. The cord plugs into the generator. They're, legally, one appliance now. You commingled them in year two.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: We commingled them?

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: You taped them together, Chen. With your name on the tape. I can email you the photo.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: He has the tape on camera, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: That sign was TRUE, Donna, and the tape is also true!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Best tacos on the block, sweetheart, on a block that is now PITCH BLACK because of YOUR generator!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Your cord! It is half your cord!

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: It's the L L C's appliance, you each own half the dark!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Then I'm suing the appliance!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: You can't sue an appliance, Donna!

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: ...Actually, with this filing, you kind of can.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um, Ronnie? <p:0.3> Our lights just came back on. The studio.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...Then somebody plugged the cord back in.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: I did not touch the cord, Donna.

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: ...I'm at the curb. I plugged it in. I'm a member of the L L C now, I added myself this afternoon. It seemed smart.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well there it is, folks. Two windows, one cord, one generator, and now a lawyer. <p:0.3> That's a family. We'll be right back, soon as somebody divorces the lawyer.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, he's already taping his name to the cord.
